noticias.titular: Lucas Spence's 3-HR night keeps Astros tied atop AL West
noticias.texto: Lucas Spence joined Joshua Baez and Seby Zavala as the only players in major league history to hit each of his first three career home runs in the same game.

noticias.titular: Red Sox 1B Contreras casts doubt on wild-card availability
noticias.texto: Red Sox first baseman Willson Contreras is uncertain whether he will be available to play when the AL Wild Card Series starts Tuesday.

noticias.titular: Guardians clinch playoff berth again, edge Red Sox 1-0
noticias.texto: The Guardians clinched a playoff spot for the third straight year after defeating the Red Sox 1-0 on Thursday.

noticias.titular: Yankees' Boone says he spoke with Judge after injury discord
noticias.texto: Aaron Boone on Thursday said he spoke with Aaron Judge after the star outfielder expressed displeasure over the manager's description of his calf strain to reporters.

noticias.titular: Phillies' Arraez, chasing batting title, exits with sprained ankle
noticias.texto: Phillies second baseman Luis Arraez left Thursday's loss against Milwaukee with a sprained left ankle after he tried to avoid a tag at first base.

noticias.titular: Yankees put Schmidt on IL; Stanton, Grisham hit again
noticias.texto: Clarke Schmidt is back on the injured list and will miss the AL Wild Card Series, sidelined by right biceps neuritis that developed following his return from Tommy John surgery.

noticias.titular: Goose at Dodger Stadium during Padres-Dodgers recalls past wildlife interruptions
noticias.texto: A goose slid on Dodger Stadium's field during Padres-Dodgers. It's not the first time a creature stole the show at a sporting event.

noticias.titular: Pirates' Paul Skenes says he won't dwell on 2026 season
noticias.texto: Paul Skenes said Thursday, after his final start of the regular season, that he doesn't view 2026 as a failure. He finished 10-11 with a 3.82 ERA.

noticias.titular: Braves to put Martín Pérez on IL (back); likely out until NLCS
noticias.texto: The Braves plan to put Martín Pérez on the 15-day IL with lower back inflammation, leaving Atlanta short-handed in its starting rotation for the postseason.

noticias.texto: The Chicago Cubs clinched their second straight postseason berth a 2-1 victory over the Miami Marlins on Thursday.
